newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BALLAST WINS ORDERS WORTH NLG 200 MLN.
newsitem.headline: BALLAST WINS ORDERS WORTH NLG 200 MLN.

text.p: Ballast Nedam NV said on Monday it had won dredging orders worth 200 million guilders.
Ballast said it had won various dredging orders, including projects in Wales and Germany, worth 40 million guilders.
Outside Europe the company said it had won orders worth 160 million guilders in Brazil, Singapore and Malaysia.
Ballast said its British subsidiary ADCC had taken delivery today of a new suction hopper dredger, one of the biggest of its kind with a hopper capacity of 18,000 cubic metres.
The new dredger will start work immediately in Southampton where it will deepen the access channel to the city's port.
When that project is completed it will move on to Hamburg for a land reclamation project for a container terminal.
